title: Jacket potatoes with feta and cucumber yoghurt

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or a plain dairy staple: potatoes, cucumber, Greek yoghurt, feta, salad vegetables, herbs and lemon.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking tray, grater, bowl and knife, and the techniques are simple baking, grating and chopping.

works.reason: Four potatoes at 200°C for 70 minutes will be crisp and cooked, and 250g yoghurt with 200g feta and a whole cucumber is right for four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is realistic for grating, chopping and slicing this salad and dip, and the 70-minute cook time matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Each name matches its id, every listed item, including the mint, lemon and pepper, is used, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A whole cucumber carries both the yoghurt dressing and the crunchy salad, which suits a fresh late-May lunch.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Jacket potatoes with feta, yoghurt and a crisp salad make a filling, balanced family lunch.
